summary: A curated list of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings with free tiers, targeted at DevOps and infrastructure engineers.
usecases: Discovering free-tier cloud services for infrastructure and DevOps projects.
Comparing SaaS, PaaS and IaaS offerings for cost planning and evaluation.
Finding tools for personal or startup projects with limited budgets.
ideas: Building a searchable web interface or API for the list.
Creating domain-specific subsets (e.g., AI/ML tools, security tools).
Integrating into CI/CD pipelines for automatic cost estimation.
